notes:
### Added
- **Canonical PKMNDB catalogue.** English, Japanese and Chinese data is now
  generated from PKMNDB's membership export: **945 sets / 69,898 card
  memberships** (28,275 English, 28,596 Japanese, 13,027 Chinese), including
  the 15 TCG Pocket app-only sets and 158 PocketVault-only variants.
- `src/data/legacy-card-map.json` (47,062 changed IDs) and
  `legacy-set-map.json` (194 changed IDs) record every old-to-new mapping.

### Changed
- Card IDs are **per-set memberships** (`<canonicalSetId>-<cleanNumber>`, with
  `-2`/`-3` suffixes for duplicate numbers) so reprint and promo memberships are
  preserved. `miscp` merges two PKMNDB sets; every other canonical set is 1:1.
- **Dexie v12** migration remaps collection, wishlist, price, grade, scan
  match, manual match and debug card/set IDs, merges duplicate collection
  variants, and clears stale fingerprints.
- `DATA_VERSION` bumps to `canonical-pkmndb-2026-10-23` so existing installs
  reseed from the canonical catalogues.
- The app now downloads the single canonical scan index at
  `scan/canonical/` (933 shards / 69,439 descriptors, `SCAN_VERSION` 5) instead
  of the frozen `scan/pocketvault/` v4 index. The 459 cards without artwork
  (400 card backs, 59 Chinese cards) are not indexed.

A scan-index rebuild was required: the descriptor version, catalogue IDs and
card data all changed. The canonical index was published on 2026-10-23.
